Trump is leaning against the ropes, congratulating the people throwing punches at him, while an entirely different fight unfolds around the ring...

Three days before the midterms, Trump posted Muhammad Ali's 1971 defeat against Joe Frazier... that caught my attention because Ali's greatest strategic masterpiece came three years later against George Foreman... the rope-a-dope...

Ali absorbed punishment against the ropes, allowing Foreman to exhaust himself while the crowd watched what appeared to be a losing fighter... then, in the eighth round, Ali came off those ropes and knocked Foreman out...

Now look at November 3... Dems capture Congress, the media celebrates, and Trump congratulates his opponents, praises their performance, and offers cooperation...

He distances himself from the losses, reminding everyone he wasn't on the ballot and still possesses presidential veto authority...

See the positioning? He's absorbing the blows while his opponents inherit responsibility for what follows...

Meanwhile another sequence was unfolding... in September, DOJ issued litigation holds covering election records in 29 states and Washington, D.C. On October 26, Trump announced a proposed $1 million election fraud reward, alongside DOJ's separate $10,000 to $30,000 fraud incentive program...

On October 29, DOJ reinforced the 22-month federal election record preservation requirement, warning against deliberate destruction... 

Then just one day before the election, a Michigan judge permanently blocked deletion of original electronic pollbooks after certification, preserving underlying data and metadata... "watch Michigan"...

Election evidence was being legally protected before the outcome was known...

Simultaneously ~1,000 DOJ monitors and observers covered 126 jurisdictions across all 50 states...

Hegseth mobilized military intelligence, Cyber Command, and the NSA against foreign interference, while DOJ's voter registration litigation tested federal authority against state sovereignty and privacy protections...

Election Day produced localized scanner failures, ballot shortages, bomb threats, and disruptions. Federal cyber monitoring reported limited threats and no identified foreign influence operations by late election night... preserved records now provide a foundation for lawful audits and investigations...

Zoom out and connect the systems... federal monitoring expanded as courts enforced constitutional boundaries... cyber defenses operated alongside evidence preservation... Congressional power shifted while the presidency retained its executive authority... and Trump is congratulating the Democrats...

Ali understood this dynamic... Foreman's aggression, confidence, and energy expenditure became variables influencing the fight... the punches were landing while conditions for Ali's counterattack developed...

Trump's Ali posts, his election response, and the institutional activity surrounding November 3 create a striking parallel...

The congressional defeat is real, legal processes continue, election records remain preserved, and Trump retains his constitutional powers...

Trump has absorbed the immediate political damage while positioning himself for the next phase...

The Democrats have their victory, the spotlight, and the illusion of victory... Trump is about to move off the ropes and come out swinging...

The war. Gas prices. Bad candidates. Historical trends. Voter frustration. Bad messaging.

Jesus fucking Christ, SHUT UP.

We had the majority. We had the presidency. We had the opportunity to deliver. And these incompetent, spineless, self-serving Republican bastards managed to turn political power into a fucking participation trophy.

Let's start with John Thune.

You spectacularly useless son of a bitch.

You had the Senate majority. You had an election integrity bill conservatives desperately wanted passed. You had millions of voters begging Republicans to demonstrate that winning elections actually meant something.

And what did you deliver?

A fucking master class in legislative impotence.

The SAVE Act became another monument to Republican paralysis while the people who elected you watched Washington's favorite collection of overpaid assholes explain why accomplishing anything was just too goddamn complicated.

You had power, John.

HAD.

And now Democrats get to enjoy the congressional authority your leadership helped squander.

What a magnificent fucking achievement. You couldn't have served Democratic interests more effectively if you'd shown up to work wearing a DNC name tag.

And don't think the rest of the Republican establishment gets a free pass. Every useless bastard who spent these last two years hiding behind parliamentary excuses, protecting his precious committee assignments, and treating the Senate like a retirement community deserves the same political eviction notice.

Get the fuck out.

Then there's Iran.

And this is where I have absolutely zero patience for the Monday-morning military strategists pretending the nuclear threat was some imaginary problem.

IRAN MUST NEVER, EVER GET A FUCKING NUCLEAR BOMB.

Not tomorrow. Not ten years from now. Not under some worthless diplomatic agreement held together with wishful thinking and another round of international bullshit.

Never.

We're talking about a regime with a long history of sponsoring terrorism, threatening Israel, brutalizing its own population, and pursuing nuclear capabilities that could fundamentally alter the security of the Middle East.

A nuclear-armed Iranian regime is a nightmare America has every reason to prevent.

And if military action was necessary to eliminate that threat, then the mission needed a clear objective and the determination to achieve it.

Destroy the nuclear weapons capability. Prevent its reconstruction. Make damn sure the regime cannot simply wait out another American administration and resume the same dangerous ambitions.

Finish the fucking job.

Because if Americans endured war, economic disruption, and soaring gasoline prices only to discover Iran could eventually rebuild its nuclear weapons program, then what the everlasting fuck was the point?

I can accept political costs for a mission that makes America and its allies safer.

I cannot accept strategic confusion, endless uncertainty, and politicians who seem incapable of explaining what victory actually means.

And here's the part Republican leadership should have understood before this election became a political slaughterhouse.

Americans were paying the price at the pump while Democrats were pounding them over affordability.

Groceries. Gas. Housing. Insurance. The cost of keeping a fucking roof over your family's head.

Democrats hammered those issues relentlessly.

And Republicans?

I hate to say I warned you.

But I warned you.

What happened last night should be a wake-up call.

It wasn't because Democrats cheated.

It wasn't because accounts on X started criticizing Trump and the GOP a month before the election.

It happened because President Trump and the Republican Party failed to deliver on what mattered most to the American people.

Did you hear what I just f'n said?

THEY FAILED THE AMERICAN PEOPLE!

For the last four to six months, all I heard on X was the same recycled bullshit from the MAGA influencers.

"Pass the SAVE Act!"

"John Thune needs to go!"

"Trump has historic support!"

Kiss my red, white and blue blooded ass!

And because these f'n frauds kept repeating the same talking points, everyone else on X convinced themselves that everything was wonderful.

But here's what some of you desperately need to understand.

X IS NOT REAL LIFE.

If I walked up to 100 random Americans and asked them who Libs of TikTok or Dr. Clown was, I'd bet 99 of them wouldn't have a fcking clue what I was talking about.

And the 100th would probably ask me if Dr. Clown was accepting new patients.

That's how disconnected from reality some accounts on here have become.

They think because somebody has 2 million followers on X, they're a household name. 

Meanwhile, the average American couldn't pick these people out of a police lineup if their life depended on it.

Nobody at the grocery store gives a shit about the latest viral AI video. Nobody at the gas pump is celebrating because an X influencer got 10,000 reposts.

INTERNET CELEBRITIES ARE NOT AMERICA.

You know what I saw outside of X?

I saw exhausted Americans.

People with bags under their eyes.

People stressed about their mortgages.

People struggling to afford groceries.

People watching their savings disappear.

People working their asses off and still falling behind.

People looking at their bank accounts and wondering how the hell they're going to make it through another month.

And I kept hearing the same heartbreaking sentence.

"I don't know what I'm going to do."

THAT was the America I was talking about.

THAT was the American who voted last night. 

Not the America you see in your carefully curated timeline.

And for the last month, I tried telling you about how ordinary Americans were reaching their breaking point.

And what happened?

You called me a traitor.

You told me I wasn't a real conservative.

You attacked me for daring to criticize our president.

You treated legitimate concerns about people's financial struggles like some kind of betrayal.

Well, guess what?

You can silence criticism inside your little MAGA bubble, but you cannot silence reality outside of it.

I'm pissed off because I saw the warning signs, spoke up about them, and watched people attack anyone who dared acknowledge them.

And now some of those same people are looking everywhere for someone to blame.

Here's my message.

Stop blaming everyone who warned you and start holding the people in power accountable.

Because here's the reality that no social media cheerleading can change.

items.tx:
Whew.

It’s finally time to rip the veil because I was not going to be the cause of disenfranchising a single voter.

I owed it to my nation to never tell anyone not to vote (and exercise their Constitutional duty to do so — and I fought for that right) and I would have never been responsible for it. I made it a promise to myself that I would not do this. 

So here goes…

I will sort of break down the system of catastrophic events that led down to tonight. Not from a political pundit. Not from a newspaper or magazine. Just a normal guy that has talked to hundreds of people on both political spectrums.

Let’s begin six months before primary season. I joined a political organization called RINO Removal Project. From the very beginning we were always told that the idea of the project was incredible. Even Charlie Kirk was in our group chat. We were constantly harassed by jealous members of the…wait for it…alleged Conservatives. You do not know what hell we have all experienced, the slander, the jealousy, the lack of support, etc. 

Now let’s get to the real meat and potatoes of what really caused this bloodbath tonight.

THE IRAN WAR: Even though every President since the 1970’s has stated that Iran was a threat, Trump gambled. But unfortunately…this was utilized by the left. I truly think this backfired immensely when he stated that this wasn’t a “war”. Optics were terrible.

EPSTEIN CLIENT LIST: Holy good God. This was one of the main things that was run on. And then nothing. They released some
“Documents” but no one was arrested for it. The only two people that were held accountable were Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell. Just think about this. Maxwell is in prison for trafficking and not one single client was arrested.

ILLEGAL IMMIGRATION: We needed millions more out of this country. Plain and simple. Replacing Greg Bovino was the worst choice ever.

PRICES OF LITERALLY EVERYTHING: We can blame everything on Joe Biden or Trump but at the end of the day, I can’t walk outside of the grocery store for less than $100. Saying things like “I would pay $50/gallon of gas to attack Iran” was the most braindead thing I have ever heard in my life. This is coming from a combat Veteran that understand what the Military Industrial Complex is before you test.

SAVE America ACT: What an absolute disaster. Don’t even get me started.

Mind you, the GOP controlled both chambers of Congress and the Presidency. I’m not putting all blame on the President. Thune is responsible. The neocons still in power (or that got primaried) are the problem. But at the end of the day…

They. Both. Don’t. Care. About. You.

But I’m kind of done with this back and forth of both sides crushing each other but we never get to the root of the problem.

>Americans are angry. 
>Americans are overworked and underpaid. (I got so much heat before by stating the simple truth)
>Americans are being surveilled even more.
>Americans are tired of sending money overseas.

Do I continue to use my voice in the political spectrum? I’m not sure. It’s very unforgiving and have been attacked relentlessly from both the left and the right when at the end of the day….

There are delusional people on both sides.

What’s going to happen? Who knows?

I’m done with GOP. We need a brand-new GOP with actual balls that love this country and not their own pocketbooks.

You failed the American people, tremendously. And that is an absolute understatement.

Plain and simple.
